summary: Frontend-only test in the Chromium web preview at 390x844. Storage was seeded with /app/tests/e2e/setup_snippet.py. Most requested flows PASS, with 0 pageerrors, but there is ONE HIGH-PRIORITY regression in the main-canvas cache. (1) Large sketch: 1 gallery image plus 39 pen strokes. The live layer (z-index 2) shows the stroke while drawing. The main SVG keeps all paths and the image during the stroke, and the stroke is committed after release (Elemente 39->40). Rect and circle previews appear in the live layer and are committed. Undo/redo works (33->32->33). The Position tool moved the image after strokes (x/y 20/50 -> -20/110), so the cache refreshes on a normal release. Long tasks per pointer move are about 77ms on both the EMPTY and the 40-element sketch: the cost no longer grows with element count, but every move still re-renders the whole ~9.7k-line DrawScreen. (2) BUG: if a pen stroke passes over the 'Elemente: N' info overlay or the 'Übersicht' legend, those overlays claim the responder (onMoveShouldSetResponder=true). The canvas has no onResponderTerminate, so the stroke is never committed and currentPath stays set. As a result isLiveDrawing stays true and the main SVG cache is FROZEN. Reproduction: 3 strokes, then a stroke ending on the badge -> Elemente stays 3 and a stuck live path stays visible. Undo then gives Elemente 2, but the canvas still shows 3 strokes, which is a stale canvas. It recovers only when the next stroke starts. (3) Naming floor plans works. Polygon 5/4/5/4 -> legend-row-0 'S1 = 18 lfm • 20,00 m²'. Tapping it (mouse and CDP touch) opens 'Grundriss benennen' with an empty default. OK 'Wohnzimmer' -> 'S1 Wohnzimmer = 18 lfm • 20,00 m²'. Cancel keeps the name, and reopening shows the current name as default. Undo removes the name and redo restores it. Whitespace removes the name. Enter submits. A touch drag on a row moves the legend without opening the modal. (4) Save and reopen via sketchId keeps the name. (5) Project PDF HTML: the table shows 'S1 – Wohnzimmer' with 20,00 m² and Gesamt. The name 'Wohn<b>&Bad' is escaped in both the table and the sketch SVG legend. BUG: the SVG legend box has a fixed width of 220, so with a name the text runs past the box and the viewBox ('Wohnzimmer = 18 lfm • 20,00 m²' ends at x=437; box right edge is 378, viewBox right edge is 388), which cuts it off in the PDF sketch image. (6) Regressions pass: image fit insertion (1600x900 at x=20, w=350) and the calculator rename (TEST_Dach -> TEST_Hauptdach via the 'Name ändern' modal). Deprecated packages detected: none in scope. SafeAreaView issues detected: none in scope.

ui_bugs.component: Sketch canvas responder + main SVG cache
ui_bugs.issue: A pen stroke (or shape drag) that moves over the info overlay ('Elemente: N', draw.tsx ~7137, onMoveShouldSetResponder={() => true}) or the legend (legendPanResponder onMoveShouldSetPanResponder: () => true, draw.tsx:848) loses the responder. The canvas View (draw.tsx ~6893) has no onResponderTerminate and no onResponderTerminationRequest, so onTouchEnd never runs. The stroke is lost, currentPath stays non-empty, isLiveDrawing stays true and mainSvgCacheRef stays frozen: undo changed Elemente 3->2 but the canvas still drew 3 strokes, plus a stuck live stroke. The cache-freeze part is a regression from this iteration; it recovers on the next stroke. This can happen on device too, because the overlays sit on top of the canvas.

svgLegendWidth is fixed at 220 (sketchSvg.ts:171), and the legend text with a name is not measured. 'Wohnzimmer = 18 lfm • 20,00 m²' ends at x=437, while the box ends at 378 and the viewBox at 388, so the text runs out of the white box and is cut off in the PDF sketch image. Longer room names make it worse.
Dragging the legend with the MOUSE from a row (the Pressable) does not move it. Dragging from the title or with touch works. Minor, web only.

issues: About 77ms of long tasks per pointer move on both the empty and the 40-element sketch in headless Chromium. The cache removes the per-element cost, but every move still runs setCurrentPath in the 9.7k-line DrawScreen, which re-renders the toolbar, overlays and legend. Consider moving the live layer into a small memoized child component with its own state or ref and requestAnimationFrame.

action_items: HIGH: In draw.tsx, add onResponderTerminate={onTouchEnd} (or a cancel handler that commits or clears currentPathRef/currentPath/tempElement) and onResponderTerminationRequest={() => !isLiveDrawing} to the canvas View (~6893).

HIGH: Change infoOverlay to onMoveShouldSetResponder={() => false} (~7140) and the legend PanResponder to onMoveShouldSetPanResponder: (_, g) => only when the gesture started on the legend, so strokes crossing them are not stolen.

HIGH: Make mainSvgCacheRef safe. Rebuild the cache when `elements` / selectedElementId / lineSegmentMeasurements identity changes, even if isLiveDrawing is true (e.g. store the deps with the cached JSX), so undo, delete or redo can never show a stale canvas.
MEDIUM: sketchSvg.ts: compute svgLegendWidth from the longest legend text (e.g. 62 + chars*9 + 15), or truncate long names, so 'S1 Wohnzimmer = … m²' fits in the box and the viewBox.
LOW: Consider isolating the live stroke into a memoized child component to avoid re-rendering the whole DrawScreen per move.
critical_code_review_comments: draw.tsx: mainSvgCacheRef.current is assigned during render. That is acceptable, but the cache validity depends only on isLiveDrawing, so any state change during a 'live' phase (undo/redo, delete, selection, measurement edits) is silently ignored until the phase ends.

draw.tsx: the legend S-numbering uses the index in getPolylineElementsWithMeasurements(), including rows hidden because total<=0. ProjectPdfService also uses the measuredPolylines index, so numbering is consistent (OK).

ProjectPdfService.ts: sketchTitle in the sketch-item

and folderHeading are not HTML-escaped (they existed before; only the area table escapes). Low priority.
draw.tsx is 9.6k lines, far above 700; split it (canvas, toolbar, legend, modals).

success_rate.frontend: 85% (17/20 checks; failures: stuck stroke + frozen cache on overlay crossing, SVG legend name overflow, legend mouse drag on row)

seed_data_creation: Only localStorage in the throwaway browser sessions (TEST_Projekt p1, TEST_Max Muster, TEST_ sketches). No backend data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Helpers: exec files into a dict g (g={}; exec(open(f).read(), g)) – plain exec in the script scope does NOT define names. build_square(page,g) draws the 5/4/5/4 polygon and enables m²; rename_row(page, idx, value, ok). large_sketch_helpers: SVG_STATS_JS (main svg z=1, live svg z=2), ELEM_COUNT_JS, pen_stroke, LONGTASK_*. Repro of the frozen cache: pen tool, 3 strokes at (30,300..380), then a stroke from (150,165) to (330,165), ending on the 'Elemente' badge, then click sketch-undo-button -> Elemente 2 but main svg still has the same path count. Gallery image: SCROLL_JS(119), click x+12,89 with expect_file_chooser, /tmp/wide.png. The SVG legend overflow check renders the decoded sketch SVG and compares the text getBBox with the rect stroke='#e3f2fd'.
rca_of_issue: Stuck stroke: the info overlay and the legend are siblings above the canvas and their onMoveShouldSetResponder returns true. RN responder negotiation on move hands the responder to them, and the canvas allows termination by default. Because the canvas has no onResponderTerminate, onTouchEnd never commits or clears currentPath. With the new cache (draw.tsx:115/6956), a non-empty currentPath in pen mode keeps isLiveDrawing=true, so the cached main <Svg> is reused even after elements change (undo), which gives a stale canvas. Mitigation: handle terminate, block termination while drawing, stop the overlays from claiming moves, and key the cache on elements identity.
